services.title: PAINTING
services.description: Garage91 Automotive Garage91 Automotive offers a comprehensive foam wash process for motorcycles that ensures thorough cleaning and protection for various parts of the bike. Here’s a step-by-step description of the process: Engine Degreaser: The process begins with a Engine Degreaser To ensure a clean and well-maintained engine, an engine degreaser is applied to the motor. This powerful cleaner is designed to break down grease, oil, and other contaminants that may have accumulated on the engine surfaces over time. It helps restore the engine’s appearance and can improve its performance. Under Chassis Wash: The undercarriage of a motorcycle is often exposed to dirt, mud, and other road debris. A thorough under chassis wash is performed to remove these contaminants, ensuring that the critical components underneath, such as the suspension, exhaust system, and frame, are clean and protected. Foam Wash: Where a specialized motorcycle foam wash product is applied to the entire surface of the bike. This foam works to loosen and remove dirt, grime, and road debris from the bike’s bodywork, including the fairings, tank, and other exterior parts. Liquid Wax: After the motorcycle has been cleaned, a high-quality liquid wax is applied to the bodywork. This wax helps restore shine, enhance the paint’s color, and provide a protective layer against environmental elements like UV rays, dirt, and water. It also makes future cleaning easier by reducing the adhesion of dirt and grime to the bike’s surfaces. Tire Polishing: The tires are an essential part of the motorcycle’s aesthetics and safety. Garage91 Automotive offers a tire polishing service that involves the application of a specialized tire polish product. This polish not only gives the tires a glossy and clean appearance but also helps protect them from cracking, fading, and other forms of damage caused by exposure to sunlight and road contaminants. Chain Cleaning and Lubrication: The motorcycle’s chain is responsible for transferring power from the engine to the rear wheel. To ensure optimal performance and longevity, Garage91 Automotive performs a thorough chain cleaning and lubrication process. The chain is carefully cleaned to remove dirt, grime, and old lubricants, and then a high-quality chain lubricant is applied to minimize friction, reduce wear and tear, and prevent rust formation. Overall, Garage91 Automotive’s motorcycle foam wash process, engine degreaser, under chassis wash, liquid wax, tire polishing, and chain cleaning and lubrication services aim to provide a comprehensive and meticulous cleaning and maintenance routine for motorcycles, ensuring they look great, perform well, and are protected from various environmental factors that can degrade their condition.
